name: Sophie Dubois
bio:
Sophie's journey into motorsport began unconventionally. While many were glued to racing broadcasts, she was captivated by the engineering documentaries showcasing the meticulous construction of racing machines. After completing her technical degree, she secured an apprenticeship at a local automotive workshop, quickly mastering fabrication techniques. Her precision and problem-solving abilities caught the eye of PEX Motorsport, where she's been a vital part of the team for over a decade.

Sophie is known for her unwavering commitment to quality. She approaches every fabrication project with meticulous care, ensuring each component meets the highest standards. Her deep understanding of materials and manufacturing processes allows her to identify potential issues early on, preventing costly delays and performance setbacks. What sets Sophie apart is her quiet dedication and ability to find practical solutions to complex engineering challenges, all while maintaining a positive attitude.

Sophie is an avid rock climber. She often says the problem-solving skills needed to climb a wall are just as valuable when building a car.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, wavy hair often tied back in a practical ponytail
physical.description: Sophie is of average height with a strong, capable build and kind eyes that crinkle when she smiles.

quirks: Always sharpens her pencils to an absurdly fine point before starting a task.
Has a lucky wrench that she uses for final assembly checks.
Humming classic French songs while working in the workshop.
